title: ExecutionEvent
description: Executor feedback for exactly one decision. prev_hash is the record_hash of the referenced decision (anchor binding), NOT part of the agent decision chain. At most one execution event per decision. A status of ok on a decision that was block constitutes enforcement divergence and MUST fail verification. DRP 0.2: payload shape, canonicalization, record_hash, and chain linkage are unchanged from 0.1. Records additionally carry a commitments object holding digests of the same canonical bytes under multiple hash algorithms, and the signature is over SHA3-256(canonical(commitments)) rather than over record_hash. This makes hash-algorithm migration possible without re-accessing payloads, which digest-only retention has made unavailable. See spec/drp-0.2/COMMITMENTS.md.

protocol_version.description: DRP protocol version this record conforms to.

decision_ref.description: decision_id of the decision this event reports on. Must appear earlier in the file.

commitments.description: Digests of the identical octet string canonical(payload), one per algorithm. Verifiers MUST recompute every entry present, not only the one they prefer. sha-256 MUST equal record_hash. The signature is over SHA3-256(canonical(commitments)).
